cash_out_routi_conservative.description: The refinance wire recomputed with the lowest ARV (stress test), in dollars: loan-dependent fees and prepaid interest follow the lower loan. Negative = cash to bring to the refi table.

CalcStep.description:
A single self-documenting line in a calculation.

`label`   - human-readable name of the variable ("Operating Expenses").
`value`   - the numeric result of the step (always a float for JSON).
`unit`    - how to read `value`: dollars, a percentage or a plain ratio.
`formula` - the literal expression evaluated, with concrete values
            substituted (e.g. "$2000 - $800 - $1000 = $200").
`terms`   - for a sum-type step, the same expression as structured operands
            (they add up to `value`), so a renderer can stack them.
`note`    - an optional aside explaining a convention or a special case.

formula.description: The expression evaluated, with the concrete numbers filled in.
formula.title: Formula

label.description: Human-readable name of the step, e.g. 'Net Operating Income (NOI)'.
label.title: Label

note.description: Optional aside: a convention or special case behind this step.
note.title: Note

terms.description: For a sum-type step: the operands of `formula`, in order; they add up to `value`. Absent on other steps.
terms.title: Terms

unit.description: How to read `value`: 'money' = dollars, 'pct' = percent (12.5 = 12.5%), 'ratio' = a plain multiple (1.2 = 1.2x).
unit.title: Unit

value.description: The step's result. Read it with `unit`; -1 and -2 are the infinite / undefined sentinels on percentage steps.
value.title: Value

CalcStep.title: CalcStep

CalcTerm.description: One operand of a sum-type calculation step, in dollars.

label.description: Name of the operand, e.g. 'Down Payment'.
label.title: Label

sign.description: Whether the operand is added or subtracted.
sign.title: Sign

step_label.description: When the operand is itself a step, that step's label (look it up in this section first, then in any section); absent for a raw input.
step_label.title: Step Label

recordingTransferRefi.description: Government recording and transfer charges at refi, in dollars. None = formula: 0.55% of the refi loan + $250.

breakdowns.description: Step-by-step calculation per headline metric, keyed by metric name (e.g. 'cash_flow', 'cash_out'): each step has a label, a value and the formula with the numbers filled in.
breakdowns.title: Breakdowns

cash_flow.description: Monthly cash flow in a regular year after the refinance, in dollars: rent minus vacancy, maintenance, capex, property management, taxes (this year's bill x 0.96 / 12), insurance (the regular-year monthly figure), HOA and the new mortgage payment. Never includes a closing lump. Negative = the property costs money every month.
cash_flow.title: Cash Flow

cash_on_cash.description: Cash-on-cash return in percent: yearly cash flow divided by the cash left in the deal. -1 means infinite (no cash left in the deal); -2 means not applicable.
cash_on_cash.title: Cash On Cash

cash_out.description: Cash out from the deal, in dollars: the total cash received from the deal (the refinance wire, see cash_out_routi) MINUS the reserves the owner sets aside at the refi (reserves_total: money that stays in the deal) MINUS the total cash put into it before the refinance (total_cash_invested). Negative means that much of your own money is still left in the deal (e.g. -26587 = $26,587 left in); positive means you took out more than you invested.
cash_out.title: Cash Out

cash_out_routi.description: 'Routi': the cash wire received at the refinance closing table, in dollars: the new loan (ARV x LTV) minus the hard-money payoff, refi closing costs and refi prepaid interest: the 'Due to Borrower' line of the refi settlement statement. The reserves are the owner's own money and are not taken off it. Gross, before subtracting what was invested (that subtraction is cash_out). Negative = cash brought to the table.
cash_out_routi.title: Cash Out Routi

cash_out_routi_conservative.description: The refinance wire recomputed with the lowest ARV (stress test), in dollars: loan-dependent fees and prepaid interest follow the lower loan. Negative = cash to bring to the refi table.
cash_out_routi_conservative.title: Cash Out Routi Conservative

cash_to_close_buy.description: Cash wired to the title company on purchase day, in dollars: down payment + buy closing costs (including the insurance bill when paid inside the closing) + hard-money points + prepaid interest (buy) - seller tax credit - earnest money deposit.
cash_to_close_buy.title: Cash To Close Buy

cash_to_refi_table_conservative.description: Cash to bring to the refi closing under the lowest ARV, in dollars: max(0, -cash_out_routi_conservative).
cash_to_refi_table_conservative.title: Cash To Refi Table Conservative

closing_costs_buy_total.description: Sum of the buy closing-cost lines, in dollars: loan charges + recording/transfer + title/escrow + online notary + other + the insurance bill when paid inside the purchase closing.
closing_costs_buy_total.title: Closing Costs Buy Total

closing_costs_refi_total.description: Sum of the refi closing-cost lines, in dollars: loan charges + recording/transfer + title/escrow + online notary + underwriting + broker points + processing + other + the insurance bill when paid inside the refi closing + the tax lump when the refi lender collects the whole bill. The appraisal and the survey are paid outside the closing and are not here.
closing_costs_refi_total.title: Closing Costs Refi Total

deed_transfer_tax_buy.description: Deed transfer tax inside the buy recording/transfer default, in dollars: $0 on a standard deal (the seller's debit), 0.70% of the purchase price when we pay all closing costs.
deed_transfer_tax_buy.title: Deed Transfer Tax Buy

dscr.description: Debt service coverage ratio after the refinance: monthly rent divided by the monthly PITIA (principal, interest, taxes, insurance and HOA). Above 1.0 the rent covers the payment; lenders usually want 1.2 or more.
dscr.title: Dscr

equity.description: Equity after the refinance, in dollars: ARV minus the new loan balance, plus the reserves the owner set aside (released with confidence at a sale).
equity.title: Equity

hml_amount.description: Total hard-money principal, in dollars: purchase loan + construction loan budget.
hml_amount.title: Hml Amount

hml_payoff.description: Hard-money payoff at the refi, in dollars: principal plus the interest accrued since the 1st of the refi month.
hml_payoff.title: Hml Payoff

hysa_deposit_at_refi_effective.description: HYSA deposit at the refi actually used, in dollars: the input, or 3 months of the DSCR loan's principal and interest when null.
hysa_deposit_at_refi_effective.title: Hysa Deposit At Refi Effective

insurance_bill_at_refi_effective.description: Insurance bill at the refi actually used, in dollars: the input, or the insurance bill at purchase when null.
insurance_bill_at_refi_effective.title: Insurance Bill At Refi Effective

lowest_arv_effective.description: Lowest ARV actually used, in dollars: the input, or 90% of ARV when null.
lowest_arv_effective.title: Lowest Arv Effective

messages.description: Reserved for input-validation warnings; currently never populated (invalid input is rejected with HTTP 400 instead), so this is null or an empty list.
messages.title: Messages

monthly_insurance_after_refi_effective.description: Insurance per month in a regular year after the refi actually used, in dollars: the input, or the insurance bill at the refi / 12 when null.
monthly_insurance_after_refi_effective.title: Monthly Insurance After Refi Effective

monthly_property_tax_after_refi.description: Property tax per month in a regular year after the refi, in dollars: this year's bill x 0.96 / 12 (paid on Nov 30 with the November discount).
monthly_property_tax_after_refi.title: Monthly Property Tax After Refi

net_profit.description: Net profit created by the deal, in dollars: equity plus cash out (a negative cash out, money left in, reduces it).
net_profit.title: Net Profit

pre_refi_rental_income.description: Rent collected between tenant placement and the refi, in dollars (30-day months); offsets holding costs.
pre_refi_rental_income.title: Pre Refi Rental Income

prepaid_interest_buy.description: Hard-money per-diem interest collected at the purchase closing from the closing date through the end of that month, in dollars. 0 when no buy closing date is set.
prepaid_interest_buy.title: Prepaid Interest Buy

prepaid_interest_refi.description: DSCR-loan per-diem interest collected at the refi closing through the end of that month, in dollars (360-day year, as the refi settlement statements quote it). 0 when no buy closing date is set.
prepaid_interest_refi.title: Prepaid Interest Refi

property_tax_bucket_balance_released_at_.description: The tax bucket's balance that comes back to the owner when the refi lender collects the whole bill, in dollars (lowers total_cash_invested). 0 otherwise.
property_tax_bucket_balance_released_at_.title: Property Tax Bucket Balance Released At Refi

property_tax_bucket_deposit_effective.description: Deposit into the property's tax bucket on each 15th until the refi actually used, in dollars: the input, or (this year's bill x 0.96 - the seller credit set aside) / the 15ths left until Nov 30 when null.
property_tax_bucket_deposit_effective.title: Property Tax Bucket Deposit Effective

property_tax_lump_sum_at_refi_closing_ef.description: The tax lump the refi lender collects, in dollars: 0 unless the full bill is collected at the refi; then the input, or this year's bill when null.
property_tax_lump_sum_at_refi_closing_ef.title: Property Tax Lump Sum At Refi Closing Effective

property_tax_paid_into_bucket_until_refi.description: Every deposit into the property's tax bucket from the purchase to the refi, in dollars.
property_tax_paid_into_bucket_until_refi.title: Property Tax Paid Into Bucket Until Refi

purchase_loan_amount.description: Hard-money loan on the purchase, in dollars: purchase price x (1 - down payment %).
purchase_loan_amount.title: Purchase Loan Amount

recording_transfer_buy_effective.description: Recording/transfer charges (buy) actually used, in dollars: the input, or its formula default when null.
recording_transfer_buy_effective.title: Recording Transfer Buy Effective

recording_transfer_refi_effective.description: Recording/transfer charges (refi) actually used, in dollars: the input, or its formula default when null.
recording_transfer_refi_effective.title: Recording Transfer Refi Effective

refi_closing_date.description: Buy closing date + days until refi (ISO).
refi_closing_date.title: Refi Closing Date

rehab_completed_date.description: Buy closing date + days until rehab completed (ISO).
rehab_completed_date.title: Rehab Completed Date

reserves_funded_from_own_pocket_at_lowes.description: The reserves the lowest-ARV wire cannot fund, in dollars: max(0, reserves_total - max(0, cash_out_routi_conservative)). Part of Cash Needed.
reserves_funded_from_own_pocket_at_lowes.title: Reserves Funded From Own Pocket At Lowest Arv

reserves_total.description: Reserves the owner sets aside at the refi, in dollars: maintenance + vacancy + capex + the HYSA deposit. Not taken off the wire; they lower cash_out (money that stays in the deal) and count as equity.
reserves_total.title: Reserves Total

roi.description: Return on investment in percent: one year of cash flow (12 x cash_flow) plus net_profit, divided by the cash left in the deal (|cash_out|). -1 means infinite (no cash left in the deal); -2 means not applicable (cash flow is 0 or negative).
roi.title: Roi

seller_tax_credit.description: Property-tax proration on the purchase settlement, in dollars. Positive = the seller credits the buyer for the days they owned this year (taxes still unpaid, billed in November); negative = the buyer credits the seller (an October to December closing by default, taxes already paid). The typed sellerTaxCreditAtPurchaseClosing when given, else the proration (0 when no buy closing date is set). A positive credit is set aside in the property's tax bucket the day after closing, so it lowers cash_to_close_buy but not total_cash_invested or Cash Needed; a negative one is a real cost.
seller_tax_credit.title: Seller Tax Credit

stolen_money.description: Lender draw spread, in dollars: construction loan budget minus actual rehab (with contingency). Positive = capital pulled out through draws before the refi; negative = extra out-of-pocket rehab.
stolen_money.title: Stolen Money

tenant_occupied_date.description: Buy closing date + days until rented (ISO).
tenant_occupied_date.title: Tenant Occupied Date

title_escrow_buy_effective.description: Title/escrow charges (buy) actually used, in dollars: the input, or its formula default when null.
title_escrow_buy_effective.title: Title Escrow Buy Effective

title_escrow_refi_effective.description: Title/escrow charges (refi) actually used, in dollars: the input, or its formula default when null.
title_escrow_refi_effective.title: Title Escrow Refi Effective

total_cash_invested.description: Everything actually spent before the refinance, in dollars: EMD + cash to close (buy) + the positive seller tax credit set aside in the property's tax bucket the day after closing + the insurance bill at purchase when paid outside the closing + rehab paid beyond the construction budget (negative when the budget exceeds the rehab) + monthly hard-money interest + HOA until refi + insurance paid monthly until refi + the tax-bucket deposits until refi + any Nov 30 shortfall topped up + utilities until rented + maintenance before refi + appliances + appraisal and survey (paid outside the refi closing) + the insurance bill at refi when paid outside the closing - pre-refi rent - the tax-bucket balance released when the refi lender collects the whole bill.
total_cash_invested.title: Total Cash Invested

total_cash_needed_for_deal.description: Cash Needed: the single definitive out-of-pocket capital through the refinance, in dollars, rounded to the cent: total_cash_invested + rehab cushion + cash_to_refi_table_conservative + reserves_funded_from_own_pocket_at_lowest_arv (the cash brought to the refi table, and the reserves the wire cannot fund, if the appraisal comes in at the lowest ARV; planned on the stress test, not the baseline). No floor and no clamping: negative means the deal gives back more than it takes. cash_needed_schedule_at_lowest_arv dates every dollar of it.
total_cash_needed_for_deal.title: Total Cash Needed For Deal

total_hard_money_cost.description: All the cost of the hard-money loan, in dollars: points + interest until the refi + loan charges (buy).
total_hard_money_cost.title: Total Hard Money Cost

vacancy_reserve_effective.description: Vacancy reserve actually used, in dollars: the input, or one month of rent when null.
vacancy_reserve_effective.title: Vacancy Reserve Effective

post.description:
Append a new REPS entry to the user's Google Sheet (append-only).

Evidence: each `evidence_items` entry becomes a clickable named link in
the Sheet's Evidence column (rich text). The user types the label in
the modal so the auditor sees `Closing meeting` instead of a 240-char
GCS URL.

Location: `location_snapshots` get rendered as breadcrumbs (START/STOP/
PAUSE/RESUME/BOOKMARK/MANUAL/PHOTO) so an auditor can verify the user
stayed at the property during the session.

post.description:
Single-file convenience shim — kept for backward compatibility.

New clients should call `/reps/upload-batch`.

Upload one or many evidence files into a per-log GCS sub-folder.

The folder + per-file URLs are returned to the frontend, which then sends
them back inside the `/reps/log` payload so the Sheet stores both the
folder URL (auditor's index page) and each file URL.
